title: Neil Armstrong's childhood home listed for sale
summary: The childhood home of astronaut Neil Armstrong, where his early aspirations for flight developed, has been put up for sale. The property offers a glimpse into the early life of the first person to walk on the Moon. The house is located in Wapakoneta, Ohio.
summary_points: Neil Armstrong's childhood home is for sale.
The home is where his dreams of flying reportedly took off.
Neil Armstrong was the first person to walk on the Moon.
The house is located in Wapakoneta, Ohio.

summary_points_hi: नील आर्मस्ट्रांग का बचपन का घर बिक्री के लिए है।
यह वह घर है जहाँ से उनके उड़ने के सपने कथित तौर पर शुरू हुए।
